name: International Protection (Asylum)

qualifying_event.description: A person outside their country of origin with a well-founded fear of persecution, or a real risk of serious harm, may apply for international protection with Lithuania's Migration Department.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Identity documents if available; evidence supporting the claim of persecution or serious harm.

requirement_groups.name: Asylum application to the Migration Department

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must show a well-founded fear of persecution (refugee status) or a real risk of serious harm (subsidiary protection) in their country of origin, assessed by Lithuania's Migration Department.
Application must be filed with the Migration Department (or at the border/State Border Guard Service upon arrival).
requirements.fix_path: File an asylum application with the Migration Department.

evidence_required.document: Evidence supporting the claim of persecution or serious harm

sources.title: UNHCR Help Lithuania -- confirms Lithuania's Migration Department (not UNHCR) runs refugee status determination directly, under national asylum law transposing the EU Qualification and Asylum Procedures Directives
